page: Microsoft Azure DC32as_v6 is a general-purpose virtual machine belonging to the DCasv6 server family. It is powered by an AMD processor utilizing the x86_64 architecture and features 32 dedicated virtual CPUs. Running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor, this instance allocates 128.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per virtual core.

This server configuration does not include any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external network-attached disks. The instance is Premium Storage capable, allowing integration with high-performance persistent storage volumes. There are no graphics processing units (GPUs) bundled with this hardware profile, and it does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given the balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the DC32as_v6 is designed for general-purpose enterprise workloads. It is suitable for hosting application servers, relational databases utilizing external Premium Storage, and multi-threaded web serving environments. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance without resource contention, offering a stable resource density for production environments.
